name: xBench-DeepSearch
description: A Chinese-language benchmark of 100 encrypted questions evaluating LLM agents' deep search and information retrieval capabilities, including fact-checking, comparative analysis, and multi-step web browsing research. Data is encrypted to prevent contamination, and new versions with fresh questions are released periodically.
reputation: Widely adopted alongside BrowseComp and BrowseComp-ZH as a standard deep-search agent evaluation; part of the xBench AGI-tracking series.
notes: Chinese-language only. Data encrypted to prevent search-engine crawling and dataset contamination; decryption code in GitHub repo. Dynamic benchmark with versioned releases (DeepSearch-2505, DeepSearch-2510). Secondary metrics include cost-per-task and time-per-task. Part of the broader xBench platform (arXiv:2506.13651).
